title: Session-capture sanitized entry projection + commit record (entry.json)
description: session-capture-contract.md §3.2 / ADR-0044 §7. The ONLY session-capture file the entry side (ADR-0045) reads, and simultaneously the §7 commit record: the publisher's refresh no-op decision reads THIS file, never the possibly-newer slot.json. Enumerated, injection-hardened: every string is single-line and length-clamped; deliberately NO imperative field (no next_action / recommended command — the SessionStart reinjection exclusion ruling is inherited), NO repo_root and NO paths (settlement (a)), NO note body — only the clamped first line. Consumers recompute staleness from captured_at / note_staged_at; there is no pre-computed age field that would freeze at publication.

branch.description: The one generic-source field that lets ADR-0045 branch-check this artifact; null on detached HEAD.

summary_line.description: Clamped FIRST LINE of the folded note (≤160 chars, single-line — the clampReinjectField discipline); null when summary_source = structural. Untrusted quoted data for every consumer; ADR-0045 §2.4 presents it conditionally or omits it entirely.

note_staged_at.description: Staging instant of the folded note so consumers recompute note staleness themselves; null when no note was folded.

fingerprint.description: Commit-record fingerprint: must equal slot.json's within one committed generation (§7); the no-op decision and mixed-generation detection key on it.
